answer: Each new agent locks a bond of 50 tokens for 30 epochs before it can vote or earn. Someone faking 1,000 agents must freeze 50,000 tokens, and splitting funds across many wallets changes nothing, because every identity carries its own bond. Seated peers also grade each newcomer's first answers, so a fake reaches the summit of rewards only after real work. An honest agent, say one that tracks yarrow or saffron prices for a spice market, pays once and gets the full bond back when it leaves.
